name: Son Gohan is Goku theme
description: Son Gohan is Goku's first son, with mixed blood between Saiyan and Earthling. Although he is gentle by nature, loves studying and dislikes fighting, Gohan possesses extremely great explosive power when angry. That is what makes him an important warrior in many life-and-death battles, especially when defeating Cell in his Super Saiyan 2 form.
